grammar.topic: Reporting verbs: suggest, advise, admit, deny, warn
explainTr: Biri bir şey söylediğinde onu 'said' ile aktarabilirsin, ama toplantı notlarında daha net fiiller kullanılır: suggest (öner), advise (tavsiye et), admit (kabul et, itiraf et), deny (inkâr et), warn (uyar). Bu fiillerin her biri farklı bir kalıpla gelir; asıl iş kalıbı ezberlemek.

suggest, admit ve deny'den sonra genelde -ing gelir: She suggested changing the bell. He denied taking the pen. Advise ve warn'dan sonra ise kişi + to gelir: She advised me to call. He warned us not to run. Olumsuzda 'not to' kullanılır.

Çok yapılan hata: 'suggest' ile 'to' kullanmak. 'She suggested me to go' yanlıştır; doğrusu 'She suggested going' veya 'She suggested that I go'. 'Advise' ise tam tersine kişiyi ister: advise SOMEONE to do.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'bana gitmemi önerdi' ve 'gitmemi tavsiye etti' neredeyse aynı yapıdır. İngilizcede ise fiile göre kalıp değişir: suggest + -ing, advise + kişi + to, admit/deny + -ing. Türkçedeki 'inkâr etti' için 'denied' ve ardından -ing gerekir.
table: He advised me to arrive early.
They warned us not to run.

reading.title: Notes from a staff meeting
reading.text:
Last Thursday, Mr. Brown sent Hafsa the notes from a staff meeting at Maple Grove Elementary. Hafsa is not a regular employee yet, but the principal wants every substitute teacher to read them. She sat down at the kitchen table with a cup of tea and read carefully.

The meeting was about a problem in the hallways. Several teachers said that students were arriving late to class after lunch. The principal, Ms. Rivera, admitted that the schedule had been confusing since September. She suggested changing the lunch bell and giving students a two-minute warning before the end of recess. Everyone agreed, except Mr. Dolan, who thought the change would cause more confusion in the cafeteria.

Next, the counselor talked about an incident on the playground. Two boys had been arguing about a ball, and one of them pushed the other. The boy who pushed denied starting the fight, but a lunch aide had seen everything. The counselor advised the teachers to speak with both students separately and to call the parents the same day. She also warned the staff not to discuss the incident with other families, because the school must protect student privacy.

Finally, the nurse reminded everyone about allergies. She warned substitute teachers to check the allergy list before giving any snacks to the class. One teacher admitted forgetting the list last month, and she promised to keep a copy on her desk from now on. The nurse recommended hanging a small card next to the door, so that anyone who enters the room can find the information quickly.

At the bottom of the page, Mr. Brown had added a short note for Hafsa. He suggested that she introduce herself to the nurse and the counselor during her first week. He also advised her to arrive twenty minutes early, since the front office gives substitutes a folder with the daily plan. Hafsa smiled. The notes were long, but they showed her how a real school solves problems together, and she felt more ready than before.

options: She had forgotten the allergy list.
The lunch schedule had been confusing since September.
She had lost the meeting notes.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'admitted that the schedule had been confusing since September.'

questions.q: What did the boy who pushed the other say?
What did the nurse warn substitute teachers to do?
options: Hang a card outside the school.
Check the allergy list before giving snacks.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'warned substitute teachers to check the allergy list'.

questions.q: What did Mr. Brown advise Hafsa to do?
options: Talk to the families about the incident.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'advised her to arrive twenty minutes early'.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hafsa, did you read the meeting notes I sent?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I did. I have one question about the field trip.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: The notes say the principal suggested moving it to May. Why?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Well, the bus company warned us that April is already full. Also, several parents admitted they couldn't take time off work in April.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I see. And what did Ms. Rivera say about the permission slips?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: She advised the teachers to send them home two weeks early. One teacher denied receiving the old forms, but they were in her mailbox.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Should I do anything as a substitute?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: I suggest checking the folder on the teacher's desk every morning. If a slip is missing, remind the student politely.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That sounds easy. Thank you for explaining everything.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Anytime. And Hafsa, don't forget to sign in at the front office.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I won't. I'm writing it down right now.

The bus company had no space in April.
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'the bus company warned us that April is already full.'

questions.q: What did Ms. Rivera advise the teachers to do?
options: Send the permission slips home two weeks early.
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'She advised the teachers to send them home two weeks early.'

questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'I suggest checking the folder on the teacher's desk every morning.'

writing.promptTr: Ziyaret ettiğin bir okul toplantısını Linda'ya anlat. En az üç farklı aktarma fiili kullan (suggest, advise, admit, deny, warn). 120-180 kelime yaz.
writing.promptEn: Write an email to Linda about a school meeting you attended. Use at least three reporting verbs (suggest, advise, admit, deny, warn).
frames: The counselor advised the teachers to ...
The nurse warned us not to ...
writing.model: Hi Linda, I want to tell you about the staff meeting I attended at Maple Grove Elementary yesterday. The principal admitted that the parking lot is too small, and she suggested using the church lot across the street. One teacher denied blocking the driveway, but the security guard said he had seen her car there. The counselor advised everyone to read the new handbook before the first day of school. She also warned us not to drop children off near the bus lane because it is dangerous. At the end, the teachers asked the parents to arrive ten minutes early for conferences. I think these ideas are reasonable, and I promised to read the handbook this weekend. Do you want to read it together? We could talk about it over tea and share our questions. I would really like to hear your opinion before I visit the school again next week. Write back soon!
checklistTr: En az üç aktarma fiili kullandın mı?
suggest/admit/deny'den sonra -ing, advise/warn'dan sonra kişi + to kullandın mı?
'suggest to' veya 'suggest me to' hatasından kaçındın mı?
E-postada selamlama ve kapanış var mı?
